0.title: Let's Build Your Resume
0.description: We'll walk you through 15 quick steps. Answer as best you can — nothing is wrong. The AI will turn your answers into a professional resume.

1.title: Contact Information
1.description: This is how employers will reach you. Only your name and contact details will appear on the resume.

2.title: Work Experience
2.description: Tell us about your jobs — including part-time, seasonal, and gig work. This is the most important section.

3.title: Education
3.description: Include any schooling you have completed or are working toward.

4.title: Volunteer Work
4.description: Unpaid work counts! Community service, church work, helping neighbors — it all shows character.

5.title: Certifications & Licenses
5.description: Check everything you have — even if it's expired, it shows training.

6.title: Skills
6.description: Check all that apply. Be honest — only check what you can do.

7.title: Military Service
7.description: Military experience is highly valued by employers. Describe your service.

8.title: Training & Courses
8.description: Any job training, online courses, or workshops you've completed.

9.title: Awards & Recognition
9.description: Employee of the month, certificates of completion, anything recognized.

10.title: Employment Gaps
10.description: If you were out of work, we can frame that positively. You are not required to disclose.

11.title: Accomplishments
11.description: Think about things you did well. These become powerful resume bullets.

12.title: Interests & Hobbies
12.description: Optional — sometimes a shared interest sparks a connection with a hiring manager.

13.title: References
13.description: Who can speak to your work? Former supervisors, coworkers, or community members.

14.title: Career Goals
14.description: Help the AI write a summary that matches what you're looking for.

15.title: Availability
15.description: This stays private — just helps us improve the service.

contact.legalNameHelper: Not shown on resume — for your records only

work.descriptionPlaceholder:
Tell us about this job. Some prompts to help:
• How many hours per week?
• Did you handle cash or a register?
• How big was your team?
• Did you train or supervise anyone?
• What equipment or software did you use?
• What are you most proud of from this job?

volunteer.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Sorted and packed food donations, assisted 100+ families weekly

certifications.title: Select all that apply
certifications.issuerPlaceholder: e.g. Red Cross, OSHA Training Institute

training.notesPlaceholder: Brief description of what you learned

gaps.title: Select any that apply to your situation
gaps.notesHelper: This will NOT appear on your resume — it helps us frame the gap positively if needed

questions.attendance: Did you have perfect or near-perfect attendance?
